claims.claim: The Lamu refinery is designed to process 700,000 barrels of crude oil per day.
claims.episode_span: The facility is designed to process 700,000 barrels of crude oil per day once complete and will be East Africa’s only refinery.
claims.source_title: Africa's richest man launches Kenya oil refinery despite land protests
claims.supporting_quote: Upon completion, the refinery is expected to process 700,000 barrels of crude oil a day, making it East Africa's largest industrial project by capacity.

claims.claim: Maxwell scored 91.9 on the Meta-World benchmark, the highest ever recorded.
claims.episode_span: A model called Maxwell, developed by the Chinese Academy of Sciences’ Institute of Artificial Intelligence for Industries, scored 91.9 on the Meta-World benchmark for robot physical tasks, the highest result recorded.
claims.source_title: Maxwell smart: new Chinese embodied model tops global AI ranking on physical tasks
claims.supporting_quote: Maxwell scored 91.9 – the highest ever recorded on the simulation benchmark.
